thought.text: Database is fully migrated (108 migrations, 103 tables, all extensions including pgrouting + postgis) and the `admin` superuser exists. Let me verify authentication works end-to-end by obtaining a JWT token through the API:

reasoning_content:
The database is fully set up:
- 108 migrations have been applied
- 103 tables
- Extensions: postgis, pgrouting, dblink, pgcrypto (all from init.sh)
- The superuser `admin` has been created

Next, let's verify that authentication works end-to-end — obtaining a JWT token via the API will be strong evidence. Let me check which endpoints the API exposes for authentication.

action.command:
cd /workspace/deployment
echo "=== auth endpoints ==="
curl -sk --resolve api.localhost:443:127.0.0.1 https://api.localhost/api/v1/ | tr ',' '\n' | grep -i "auth\|token\|login" | head
echo "=== login as admin ==="
curl -sk --resolve api.localhost:443:127.0.0.1 -X POST https://api.localhost/api/v1/auth/login/ -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"username":"admin","password":"Admin!LocalDev123"}' -w "\nHTTP %{http_code}\n" | head -c 700
